{{Quote|This is 8t88 to Imperial shuttle. You are quite prompt."<br />"Ready to take you aboard."<br />"There's no need to land, just lower the ramp."<br />"Copy.|8t88 and the shuttle pilot|<ref name="RA:AD" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''pilot''' serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], flew<ref name="RA:AD" /> the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]<ref name="JK">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> [[Furious (Lambda-class)|''Furious'']].<ref name="RA:AD" />

==History==
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II|Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> he had the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]].<ref name="RA" />

On that year, he had the orders to pick up on the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], while the droid [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|conducted business]] there on behalf of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]].<ref name="RA" />

When 8t88 arrived at the [[Launch Deck Three]], the shuttle appeared soon after and the droid radioed the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to commend his precision on time, and that he would talk to the pilot's superiors about his punctuality. That time the pilot found 8t88 being pursued by [[Kyle Katarn]], a client that 8t88 tried to double-cross. 8t88 ordered the pilot to drop ''Furious''<nowiki>'</nowiki> ramp instead of land, so that 8t88 could climb aboard as soon as possible.<ref name="RA" />

After a brief shootout, a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] from the shuttle helped the injured droid to board, and shot one of the droid's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] who attempted to followe them to the lock, the pilot then flew the ''Furious'' away from the landing platform.<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
